content: मार्जन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [मृज्-ल्यु ल्युट् वा] Cleansing, purifying. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Cleansing, cleaning, purifying; <ls>Śukra. 4. 345</ls>. .²2 Wiping or rubbing off. .²3 Effacing, wiping away; तेन व्यातेनिरे भीमा भीमार्जनफलाननाः <ls>Ki. 15. 42</ls>. .²4 Cleansing the person by rubbing it with unguents. .²5 Sprinkling the person with water by means of the hand, a blade of Kuśa grass <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-नः@} The tree called {%Lodhra%}. .{@-ना@} .²1 Cleansing, purifying, cleaning. .²2 The sound of a drum; मायूरी मदयति मार्जना मनांसि <ls>M. 1. 21</ls>. .²3 Performance with the fingers on a musical instrument. .{@-नी@} .²1 A broom, brush. .²2 Purification. .²3 A washerwoman.
